task_message:
Case F33: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 191x191x121 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Segmenta on complete. 

**Summary:** The lesion was a well-defined, lobulated high-T2-signal soft-tissue mass located superficially in the posterolateral subcutaneous tissue. I:
1. Scanned axial, coronal and sagittal planes to localise the abnormality (axial ~19–51, coronal ~56–81, sagittal ~47–74).
2. Seeded it with a single positive point inside the mass, which produced a clean 8.3 mL, single-component mask.
3. Ran a model refine to snap the boundary and verified coverage on the upper/lower ends and on interior slices in all three planes; the automatic candidate search found no missed lesion tissue.
4. Saved the final mask (v2, 8.3 mL) with medium confidence.
